blocks.text: The Problems of Korea’s Educational Policies
There are two main problems in the education system of Korea.
First of all, because the population of Korea is continually on the rise, competition within the educational system also increases.
The second is that there is a wide gap between the educational opportunities given to those who have money and those who do not.
Working together, we need to solve these problems, and provide the chance for all to obtain a good education.
